layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12

components.card: Rounded-2xl or Rounded-3xl, bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden

button.primary: bg-[#5C6B3E] hover:bg-[#7A8C54] text-white font-medium py-3 px-6 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(92,107,62,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(92,107,62,0.5)]
button.secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white font-medium py-3 px-6 rounded-xl border border-white/10 transition-all duration-300
button.ghost: bg-transparent hover:bg-white/5 text-neutral-300 py-2 px-4 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200

components.input: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#5C6B3E] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#5C6B3E] transition-all duration-300 placeholder:text-neutral-600
components.feature_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#5C6B3E]/10 border border-[#5C6B3E]/30 text-[#7A8C54] text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider

icons.style: Duotone or Regular, matching the sleek and professional fintech vibe.

structure: Header: Greeting + Profile Avatar + Notification Bell
Hero Section: Total Balance (Bento Grid 8-cols) with dynamic glowing background.
Quick Actions: Deposit, Withdraw, Swap (Bento Grid 4-cols).
Currency Wallets: Horizontal scroll or Grid of compact cards for USD, USDC, USDT, NGN.
Quick Converter Widget: Minimalist inputs with swap icon in the middle.
Recent Transactions: Clean list, with distinct icons for In/Out, amounts aligned right.
Hero Card: Net Worth with large typography and trend indicator (green/red).
Individual Wallet Cards: Detailed cards for USD, USDC, USDT, NGN showing balance, account details, and quick actions per currency.
Currency Converter: More prominent widget for executing swaps.
Transaction History: Filterable list specific to the selected wallet.

test_attributes.rules: All interactive elements must include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='deposit-button', data-testid='total-balance', data-testid='currency-selector'.
